item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure will bring showers to southern China. Another surge of the easterly airstream is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Monday. It will be windier over the region in the following couple of days. Upper-air disturbances will bring unsettled weather to southern China midweek next week.
